text: 创业板指跌超2%，沪指跌超1%，深成指跌1.87%，贵金属、白酒、房地产、PCB等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超4400只。
text_en: The ChiNext Index fell more than 2%, the Shanghai Composite Index fell more than 1%, and the Shenzhen Component Index fell 1.87%. Precious metals, baijiu, real estate, PCB and other sectors led the declines, with more than 4,400 stocks falling across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets.
